premises.text: Restaurants sell perishable seats yet charge the same price at busy and empty times, wasting inventory
premises.evidence_span: you end up paying the exact same price for your meal at both those occasions. Well, this doesn't make economic sense, at least not for a perishable inventory

premises.text: About 40% of restaurant inventory is underutilized without yield management, contributing to failure and food waste
premises.evidence_span: about 40% of the restaurant inventory is underutilized due to lack of revenue or yield management

premises.text: ResGuru dynamically changes prices from demand and supply as a restaurant GDS
premises.evidence_span: global distribution system for restaurants, which allows them to change their prices automatically based on demand and supply

premises.text: POS-integrated diary consolidates channels and shows utilization and RevPASH analytics
premises.evidence_span: all my reservations, all my food orders are consolidated from across all the online and offline channels

premises.text: Engine forecasts demand from many variables and history to price each time slot under owner goals and rules
premises.evidence_span: 21 different variables, macro and micro data points, and along with historical trends to forecast the demand

value.text: Raise restaurant utilization and revenue through automatic demand-based pricing

secondary_value.text: Diners may get better deals at off-peak times
secondary_value.evidence_span: get you better deals in your restaurants

causal_links.evidence_span: change their prices automatically based on demand and supply

notes: Independent run: food-waste/failure folded into underutilization. Pilot KPI lifts as traction of mechanism. Two-domain partition.
